baseDraft.context: Evaluate the current Digi Tools Prompt Builder as a working local-first product. Preserve the C.R.A.F.T. workflow, card system, accessibility, and existing visual direction.
baseDraft.action:
Inspect the configured workflow.
Identify what the selected cards and Snap Points change.
Report any visual or interaction ambiguity.
baseDraft.formatNotes: Make the result easy to verify against the visible interface.
baseDraft.targetAudience: A product designer and frontend developer reviewing the next iteration.

scenarios.name: Research report
scenarios.proves: Maximum context depth, evidence rigor, and report vocabulary.

draft.context: Prepare a source-grounded assessment of the Prompt Builder design system, including its interaction rules, accessibility requirements, unresolved risks, and evidence for each recommendation.

checks: Context vocabulary reads as report-oriented rather than generic.
The deck shows dossier, audit, and evidence-oriented card grades.
The live output includes traceable evidence instructions.

scenarios.name: Quick priority list
scenarios.proves: A deliberately lean configuration still feels complete.

draft.formatNotes: Keep the list brief and immediately actionable.

checks: Low-detail cards use shorter names and descriptions.
Empty slots remain intentional rather than looking broken.
The output remains useful without filling every slot.

scenarios.name: Code implementation
scenarios.proves: Code-specific vocabulary, full action order, and technical roles.

draft.context: Implement and verify a production-ready frontend feature in the existing Next.js application. Follow the installed versions and project conventions.

checks: Context labels include Full Specification and other code vocabulary.
All five Action slots communicate a clear execution sequence.
The generated Action section follows the slot order.

scenarios.name: Three-role loadout
scenarios.proves: Lead/support hierarchy and role drag-to-slot behavior.
checks: Developer is visibly the lead and the other roles are supporting.
Drag a role between slots and confirm its order changes.
The live role prompt preserves the same lead/support order.

scenarios.name: Five-step action sequence
scenarios.proves: Maximum Action density, order, and slot placement.
checks: All five slots remain readable at once.
Move a card to another slot and confirm exact placement is preserved.
The output numbers tactics in the visible slot order.

scenarios.name: Card morphing
scenarios.proves: A surviving lineage changes grade without changing position.
checks: Note the Pattern Review card name and deck position.
Move Challenge from Supportive through Critical to Adversarial.
The card becomes Adversarial Analysis in the same physical position.

scenarios.name: Card removal
scenarios.proves: An incompatible equipped card leaves its slot cleanly.
checks: Assumption Register begins equipped in slot two.
Move Context Depth to the first Snap Point.
The incompatible card is unequipped and its lineage position becomes vacant.

scenarios.name: Compatible replacement
scenarios.proves: The nearest replacement cue is noticeable but never automatic.
checks: Move Challenge to Supportive so Criteria Check becomes invalid.
A compatible card pulses no more than three times.
The suggested card remains unequipped until you choose it.

scenarios.name: Snap Memory
scenarios.proves: An exact track combination restores its previous slot arrangement.
checks: Remember the unusual Success, Assumptions, Evidence slot order.
Move both Context tracks to different points and equip another arrangement.
Return to Detailed plus Corroborated and confirm the exact order returns.

scenarios.name: Output-type change
scenarios.proves: Vocabulary changes while manual track overrides survive.
checks: The report begins with deliberately overridden low settings.
Change the Output Type to Presentation or Code.
Overrides remain and Apply recommended setup becomes available.

scenarios.name: Full and empty states
scenarios.proves: Filled and open slots coexist without layout collapse.
checks: Inspect the fully occupied Action board at maximum density.
Remove every Action card and inspect the five-slot empty state.
Both extremes preserve hierarchy and clear next actions.

scenarios.name: Responsive and keyboard
scenarios.proves: The workflow remains usable without dragging or desktop width.
checks: Narrow the browser and confirm there is no horizontal page scrolling.
Use Tab, arrow keys, Space, and Enter to operate tracks and cards.
Complete a section without using drag-and-drop.
